name: expfit
expr: [mu_b, ci_b] = expfit(x); [mu_c, ci_c] = expfit(x, 0.05, cens); [mu_f, ci_f] = expfit(x, 0.05, [], freq); [mu_cf, ci_cf] = expfit(x, 0.05, cens, freq);
comment: Sig: [muhat, muci] = expfit(x[, alpha[, censoring[, freq]]]). MLE for exponential: T = Σ(freq·x), D = Σ(freq·(1-cens)), mu = T/D. Exact CI via χ²(2D): [2T/χ²₁₋α/2, 2T/χ²_α/2]. Defaults: cens=0, freq=1.
